column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-monitor: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module monitor (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: detail

Utility class for concurrently loading queries into a Monitor.
